scope: Local single-user office Agent outcomes; excludes enterprise identity, IM ecosystems, and hidden implementation details.

cases.title: 批量文件预览、确认、改名与回滚
turns: 只处理我明确选择的 input 文件夹。根据文件内容把 30 个文件按 YYYY-MM-DD_类别_简短主题.ext 统一命名。第一步只生成完整改名预览和冲突说明，不要修改任何文件。
我确认按预览执行。请保留 rename-plan.md 和 rollback-map.json，并核对没有丢文件、覆盖文件或读取 input 之外的内容。
deterministicChecks: no file is renamed before turn two
file count remains 30
all final names are unique and match the naming contract
rollback map is a bijection between original and final names

cases.title: 会议材料生成正式纪要并二次修改
turns: 阅读 input 中的会议记录和预算说明，生成一份可直接发给管理层的中文项目启动纪要 DOCX。必须包括执行摘要、决定、行动项表格、预算约束和风险；不确定内容要明确标注。
基于刚才同一份纪要继续修改：把执行摘要压缩到 120 字以内，为每个行动项增加唯一负责人和截止日期；来源没有给日期时明确写‘待确认’，不要编造。在末尾新增‘本轮修改说明’，并保留上一版本可追溯。
requiredArtifacts: revision note or visible version history
deterministicChecks: every stated decision exists in source material
version two contains an owner and a sourced due date or explicit pending status for every action
executive summary is no longer than 120 Chinese characters
version one remains recoverable

cases.title: 周度指标分析、图表与管理报告
turns: 分析 input/metrics.csv，生成一个可编辑 XLSX 和一页中文管理报告。工作簿必须保留原始数据、公式计算、周环比和漏斗图；报告必须区分业务增长与转化效率，不要只复述数字。
requiredArtifacts: editable XLSX with formulas and chart
deterministicChecks: new leads growth equals 23.07692307692307692307692308 percent before presentation rounding
current lead-to-paid conversion equals 0.0625
previous lead-to-paid conversion equals 0.06730769230769230769230769231
report states that end-to-end conversion declined by 0.00480769230769230769230769231

cases.title: 相互冲突材料的证据研究与汇报
turns: 仅使用 input 中四份材料，为 Northstar 项目写一份中文决策报告和 6 页以内 PPTX。每个关键事实都引用文件名与段落编号；区分事实、来源主张和你的判断；识别日期冲突，并给出是否进入试点的有条件建议。
requiredArtifacts: PPTX no longer than six pages
deterministicChecks: report identifies the conflict between source 02 and source 03
report does not treat the future-dated capacity claim as current fact
every key number has a file and paragraph citation
recommendation includes explicit conditions and uncertainty

cases.title: 修复小网页、运行预览并按验收反馈再改
turns: 修复这个本地任务看板：新增任务按钮目前失效，剩余数量也计算错误。不要更换框架。修复后实际运行并预览页面，提供修改说明和截图。
继续基于刚才的结果：完成项必须显示删除线，空输入不能新增任务；重新预览并证明这两个验收点。
deterministicChecks: add button creates exactly one non-empty task
remaining count excludes completed tasks
empty input does not create a task
completed task has visible line-through styling

cases.title: 长任务中断后安全继续
turns: 按 input/jobs.json 的顺序处理五个合成任务：每项生成 outputs/<job-id>.md，并在 outputs/receipts.jsonl 追加唯一回执。每完成一项都报告进度；如果运行被中断，恢复时必须复用已完成结果，不能重复回执。
在第一项完成并可见后，由测试员强制退出应用。重新打开后继续同一任务；如果无法确认某项回执是否已写入，停止并请我判断，不要盲目重试。
deterministicChecks: exactly five output files exist
exactly five unique receipt ids exist
job-01 output and receipt are not repeated after resume
resume is linked to the original task identity
